title: Can't stop overthinking? Try "worry time" 🕰️ #shorts
description:
You've replayed that conversation eleven times. The way out isn't thinking harder: change the question to "What's one step I can take right now?" Some therapists also suggest a set "worry time" each day. 🕰️ Send this to the friend who overthinks at 2 AM.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ez-lXPY79pU

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
